<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>global.ProminUtils</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Contains utility methods for process mining
      /*  
      1. To validate all insert/update operation of child table definition
      2. To get workbench URL when clicked on "View in Workspace" 
      3.  To get UI Action ID for showing a link with project ("Go to Analyst Workbench")
      4. To Show/Hide Global Context Menu "Launch Process Mining"
      */
    </description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>ProminUtils</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var ProminUtils = Class.create();
ProminUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.table = {
            "activityDef": "promin_activity_def",
            "breakdownDef": "promin_breakdown_field"
        };

        this.findingDefinitionTableAllowed = {
            "automated": "promin_automated_finding",
            "rule-based": "promin_finding_def",
        };
        
        this._initializeConfig();
    },
    _initializeConfig: function() {
        this.isMSPInstance = GlidePluginManager.isActive('com.glide.domain.msp_extensions.installer');
        this.rowLimitForTableDef = {};
        this.rowLimitForTableDef[this.table.activityDef] = {
            "parentProperty": "promin.limit.total_activity",
            "defaultParentsAllowed": 10,
            "childProperty": "promin.limit.child_total_activity",
            "defaultChildsAllowed": 5
        };
        this.rowLimitForTableDef[this.table.breakdownDef] = {
            "parentProperty": "promin.limit.breakdown_def",
            "defaultParentsAllowed": 10,
            "childProperty": "promin.limit.child_breakdown_def",
            "defaultChildsAllowed": 5
        };
        this.defaultActivityAllowed = {
            "parentProperty": "promin.limit.default_activity",
            "parentLimit": 5,
            "childProperty": "promin.limit.child_default_activity",
            "childLimit": 3
        };
    },
    validateActivityDef: function(grActivityDef) {
        try {
            this._validateDefaultActivityLimit(grActivityDef);
            this._validateTableDefinition(grActivityDef);
            this._hasDuplicateDisplayName(grActivityDef);
            this._validateDotWalkLevelsForActivityDef(grActivityDef);
            this._validateAllowedField(grActivityDef);
            this._validateNoAOIWithDotWalk(grActivityDef);
            this._validateActivityOfInterest(grActivityDef);
            this._validateFieldValues(grActivityDef);
            this._validateDisplayOrder(grActivityDef);
            this._validateCompoundActivity(grActivityDef);
            if (grActivityDef.getValue("type") != "DEFAULT") {
                this._validateAttachedEntityActivity(grActivityDef);
            }
            this._validateStringAndJournalFieldsAreGrouped(grActivityDef);
        } catch (error) {
            grActivityDef.setAbortAction(true);
            gs.addErrorMessage(error);
            gs.error(error);
            action.setRedirectURL(current);
        }
    },
    _validateStringAndJournalFieldsAreGrouped: function(grActivityDef) {
        var source = grActivityDef.entity.source_type;
        if (source == "EXTERNAL_DATA" || source == "AGENTIC_AI_DATA") {
            return;
        }
        var tableName = grActivityDef.entity.table;
        if (source == "ARCHIVED_DATA" && tableName.startsWith("ar_")) {
            tableName = tableName.substring(3);
        }
        if (grActivityDef.getValue("type") == "DEFAULT") {
            var internalType = this.getInternalTypeOfSelectedField(tableName, grActivityDef.field);
            if ((internalType == 'string' || internalType == 'journal_input') && !grActivityDef.track_change) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Textual or Journal fields can only be added as grouped activity");
            }
        }
    },
    _validateCompoundActivity: function(grActivityDef) {
        var type = grActivityDef.type;
        if (type == "COMPOUND") {
            var fields = grActivityDef.field.split(",");
            if (fields.length < 2) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Activity of type 'Compound' cannot be created on single field. Please choose atleast 2 or more fields");
            }
        }
    },
    _validateActivityOfInterest: function(grActivityDef) {
        if (grActivityDef.activity_of_interest && grActivityDef.track_change) {
            throw gs.getMessage("Contextual activity cannot be grouped.");
        }
    },
    _validateFieldValues: function(grActivityDef) {
        if (grActivityDef.field_values_selection_type != "ALL" && !grActivityDef.field_values) {
            throw gs.getMessage("Please select the activity values or 'Choose activity values to' All before proceeding.");
        }
    },
    _validateDisplayOrder: function(grActivityDef) {
        if (gs.nil(grActivityDef.getValue("display_order")) || grActivityDef.activity_of_interest) {
            grActivityDef.setValue("display_order", 50);
        }
        if (parseInt(grActivityDef.getValue("display_order")) < -1000 || parseInt(grActivityDef.getValue("display_order")) > 1000) {
            throw gs.getMessage("Please select a valid display order between range -1000 to 1000");
        }
    },
    _validateDefaultActivityLimit: function(grProminTable) {
        if (grProminTable.getValue("type") == "DEFAULT" &&
            grProminTable.getValue("activity_of_interest") == false) {
            var limit;
            if (this._isDefinitionForParent(grProminTable)) {
                limit = gs.getProperty(this.defaultActivityAllowed.parentProperty, this.defaultActivityAllowed.parentLimit);
            } else {
                limit = gs.getProperty(this.defaultActivityAllowed.childProperty, this.defaultActivityAllowed.childLimit);
            }
            var gaTable = new GlideAggregate(grProminTable.getTableName());
            gaTable.addQuery("entity", grProminTable.getValue("entity"));
            gaTable.addQuery("type", "DEFAULT");
            gaTable.addQuery("activity_of_interest", false);
            if (grProminTable.operation() === "update") {
                gaTable.addQuery("sys_id", "!=", grProminTable.getUniqueValue());
            }
            gaTable.addAggregate("COUNT");
            gaTable.query();
            if (gaTable.next()) {
                var count = gaTable.getAggregate("COUNT");
                if (parseInt(count) >= parseInt(limit)) {
                    throw gs.getMessage("You can enter up to {0} Field Values (Default) type {1}s for this table configuration.",
                        [limit, grProminTable.getClassDisplayValue()]);
                }
            }
        }
    },
    _validateDotWalkLevelsForActivityDef: function(grActivityDef) {
        var activityValue = grActivityDef.field;
        if (activityValue.contains(".")) {
            var limit = gs.getProperty("promin.limit.max_activity_dot_walk_levels", 3);
            var activity = activityValue.split(".");
            var levels = activity.length;
            if (levels > parseInt(limit)) {
                throw gs.getMessage("The limit for dot walking in activity field is {0} levels e.g. CI.BusinessService.assignment group", limit);
            }
        }
    },
    _validateAllowedField: function(grConfigTable) {
        if (grConfigTable.getTableName() == "promin_activity_def" && grConfigTable.type != "DEFAULT") {
            return;
        }
        if (grConfigTable.getTableName() != "promin_activity_def" || grConfigTable.entity.source_type != "AGENTIC_AI_DATA") {
            var isValidField = new ProminAllowedColumns().getAllowedColumnList(grConfigTable.getTableName(), grConfigTable.entity.table, grConfigTable.field, grConfigTable.entity);
            if (!isValidField && !this._validateAllowedFieldsMDMForExternalAndArchived(grConfigTable)) {
                var internalType = this.getInternalTypeOfSelectedField(grConfigTable.entity.table, grConfigTable.field);
                if (internalType == 'integer') {
                    throw gs.getMessage("Numbers or Integer fields are not allowed. Please select another field.");
                } else {
                    throw gs.getMessage("Fields of type {0} are not allowed. Please select another field.", [internalType]);
                }
            }
        }
    },
    getInternalTypeOfSelectedField: function(table, field) {
        var selectedField = field.split('.');
        var totalLength = selectedField.length - 1;
        if (selectedField.length >= 2) {
            for (var i = 0; i < totalLength; i++) {
                var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
                gr.query();
                if (gr.next() && gr[selectedField[i]].getRefRecord().getTableName() !== 'undefined') {
                    table = gr[selectedField[i]].getRefRecord().getTableName();
                    field = selectedField[i + 1];
                }
            }
        }
        var recObj = new GlideRecord(table);
        var glideElement = recObj.getElement(field);
        var descriptor = glideElement.getED();
        var type = descriptor.getInternalType();
		if((type == "string" || type == "integer") && descriptor.isChoiceTable()) {
			return "choice";
		}
		return type;
    },

    _validateAllowedFieldsMDMForExternalAndArchived: function(grConfigTable) {
        if (grConfigTable.getTableName() == "promin_breakdown_field") {
            return false;
        }

        var field = grConfigTable.field;
        var grEntity = new GlideRecord("promin_project_entity");
        grEntity.addQuery("parent_entity", grConfigTable.entity);
        grEntity.addQuery("source_type", "IN", "ARCHIVED_DATA,EXTERNAL_DATA");
        grEntity.query();
        while (grEntity.next()) {
            if (field == grEntity.target_field) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    },
    _validateNoAOIWithDotWalk: function(grActivityDef) {
        var activityValue = grActivityDef.field;
        if (activityValue.contains(".") && grActivityDef.activity_of_interest == true) {
            throw gs.getMessage("The 'Contextual activity' cannot be selected with dot walk functionality. Please either uncheck 'Contextual activity' or select an activity definition 'Field' without dot walk.");
        }
    },
    _validateAttachedEntityActivity: function(activityDefGr) {
        var type = activityDefGr.type;
        if (type == "CHILD_ATTACHED") {
            var grEntity = new GlideRecord("promin_project_entity");
            if (!grEntity.get(activityDefGr.attached_entity)) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Invalid child attached '{0}'. Table Configuration not found.", activityDefGr.attached_entity);
            } else if (grEntity.project != activityDefGr.entity.project || grEntity.parent_entity != activityDefGr.entity || grEntity.relation_type != "CHILD") {
                throw gs.getMessage("Invalid child attached '{0}'. Please attach a table configuration of 'Child' relation type for '{1}' table configuration within this project.", [activityDefGr.attached_entity.getDisplayValue(), activityDefGr.entity.getDisplayValue()]);
            }
        } else if (type == "PARENT_ATTACHED") {
            if (activityDefGr.entity.relation_type != "REFERENCE") {
                throw gs.getMessage("Invalid parent attached '{0}'. Please attach a table configuration of 'Reference' relation type for '{1}' table configuration within this project.", [activityDefGr.attached_entity.getDisplayValue(), activityDefGr.entity.getDisplayValue()]);
            } else if (activityDefGr.entity.parent_entity.getValue('sys_id') != activityDefGr.attached_entity) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Invalid parent attached '{0}'.", activityDefGr.attached_entity.getDisplayValue());
            }
        }
    },
    _hasDuplicateDisplayName: function(grProminTable) {
        if (grProminTable.getValue('display_name')) {
            var gaProminTable = new GlideAggregate(grProminTable.getTableName());
            var currentName = grProminTable.getValue('display_name');
            gaProminTable.addQuery('entity', grProminTable.getValue('entity'));
            gaProminTable.addQuery('display_name', currentName);
            gaProminTable.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', grProminTable.getUniqueValue());
            gaProminTable.addAggregate("COUNT");
            gaProminTable.query();
            if (gaProminTable.next()) {
                if (gaProminTable.getAggregate('COUNT') > 0) {
                    throw gs.getMessage("Duplicate display name: '{0}' is already present in another {1}. Please try giving another display name",
                        [currentName, grProminTable.getClassDisplayValue()]
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    },
    validateBreakdownDef: function(grBreakdown) {
        try {
            this._validateDotWalkLevels(grBreakdown);
            this._validateTableDefinition(grBreakdown);
            this._validateAllowedField(grBreakdown);
            this._hasDuplicateDisplayName(grBreakdown);
        } catch (error) {
            grBreakdown.setAbortAction(true);
            gs.addErrorMessage(error);
            gs.error(error);
            action.setRedirectURL(current);
        }
    },
    validatePermission: function(grPermission) {
        this._validateShareProject(grPermission);
    },
    _validateTableDefinition: function(grConfigTable) {
        try {
            if (!grConfigTable.isValid()) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Can not validate definition change.");
            }
            var tableName = grConfigTable.getTableName();
            this._canCreateChildTableDefinition(grConfigTable);
            this._isExceedTableDefRowLimit(grConfigTable, this.rowLimitForTableDef[tableName]);
            this._isDuplicateChildTableDefPresent(grConfigTable);


        } catch (error) {
            gs.error(error);
            gs.addErrorMessage(error);
            grConfigTable.setAbortAction(true);
        }
    },
    _canCreateChildTableDefinition: function(grEntityConfigDef) {
        if (grEntityConfigDef.operation() == "insert") {

            /* used in insert BR of activity/breakdown */
            var grProject = grEntityConfigDef.entity.project.getRefRecord();

            if (gs.nil(grProject) || !grProject.isValidRecord())
                throw gs.getMessage("Invalid project");

            var canCreateNewRecord = new global.ProminACLUtil(grProject).canWriteInChildTableDef();

            if (!canCreateNewRecord && (grProject.getValue('sys_created_by') != gs.getUserName())) {
                throw gs.getMessage('You do not have required permission to create a new {0}.', [
                    grEntityConfigDef.getClassDisplayValue().toLowerCase()
                ]);
            }
        }
    },
    _isExceedTableDefRowLimit: function(grProminTable, tableDefLimits) {
        if (grProminTable.operation() === 'insert') {
            var limit;
            if (this._isDefinitionForParent(grProminTable)) {
                limit = gs.getProperty(tableDefLimits.parentProperty, tableDefLimits.defaultParentsAllowed);
            } else {
                limit = gs.getProperty(tableDefLimits.childProperty, tableDefLimits.defaultChildsAllowed);
            }
            var gaTable = new GlideAggregate(grProminTable.getTableName());
            gaTable.addQuery("entity", grProminTable.getValue("entity"));
            gaTable.addAggregate("COUNT");
            gaTable.query();
            if (gaTable.next()) {
                var count = gaTable.getAggregate("COUNT");
                if (parseInt(count) >= parseInt(limit)) {
                    throw gs.getMessage("You can enter up to {0} {1}s for this table configuration.",
                        [limit, grProminTable.getClassDisplayValue()]);
                }
            }
        }
    },
    _isDefinitionForParent: function(grConfigTable) {
        return gs.nil(grConfigTable.entity.parent_entity);
    },
    /** Check for duplicate child table definition starts **/
    _isDuplicateChildTableDefPresent: function(grProminTable) {
        var gaProminTable = new GlideAggregate(grProminTable.getTableName());
        gaProminTable.addEncodedQuery(this._getQueryForDuplicateRecordCheck(grProminTable), true);
        gaProminTable.addAggregate("COUNT");
        gaProminTable.query();
        if (gaProminTable.next()) {
            if (gaProminTable.getAggregate('COUNT') > 0) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Duplicate Record: {0} is already present as {1} ",
                    [this._getDuplicateFieldLabel(grProminTable), grProminTable.getClassDisplayValue()]
                );
            }
        }
    },
    _getQueryForDuplicateRecordCheck: function(grProminTable) {
        var query = '';
        var uniqueFieldsByTable = {};
        uniqueFieldsByTable[this.table.activityDef] = ["entity", "field", "attached_entity"];
        uniqueFieldsByTable[this.table.breakdownDef] = ["entity", "field"];

        var uniqueFields = uniqueFieldsByTable[grProminTable.getTableName()];
        if (uniqueFields) {
            uniqueFields.forEach(function(field) {
                if (grProminTable.getValue(field)) {
                    query += field + '=' + grProminTable.getValue(field) + '^';
                }
            });
            if (grProminTable.operation() === 'update') {
                query += 'sys_id!=' + grProminTable.getUniqueValue();
            }
            if (grProminTable.getTableName() == this.table.activityDef) {
                if (grProminTable.getValue('type') != 'DEFAULT' && grProminTable.getValue('type') != 'COMPOUND' && grProminTable.getValue('type') != 'DATE_TIME') {
                    query += 'type=' + grProminTable.getValue('type') + '^';
                }
            }
        }
        return query;
    },
    _getDuplicateFieldLabel: function(grProminTable) {
        var tableName = grProminTable.entity.table;
        var fieldName = grProminTable.getValue("field");
        if (grProminTable.getTableName() == "promin_activity_def" && !fieldName) {
            return "The attached entity '" + grProminTable.getDisplayValue("attached_entity") + "'";
        }
        var tables = '';
        tables += new TableUtils(tableName).getTables().toString();
        if (tables) {
            var grDictionary = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
            grDictionary.addQuery('name', 'IN', tables.replace(/[\][]/g, '').replace(/ +?/g, ''));
            grDictionary.addQuery('element', fieldName);
            grDictionary.query();
            if (grDictionary.next()) {
                return "'" + grDictionary.getValue('column_label') + "'";
            }
        }
        return '';

    },
    _validateShareProject: function(grPermission) {
        try {
            if (gs.nil(grPermission)) {
                throw gs.getMessage("Invalid record");
            }
            var canShare = new global.ProminACLUtil(grPermission.project).canShareProject();
            if (!canShare) {
                throw gs.getMessage('You do not have required permissions to share this project.');
            }
            this._checkDomainOfUserAndGroup(grPermission);

        } catch (error) {
            gs.error(error);
            gs.addErrorMessage(error);
            grPermission.setAbortAction(true);
        }
    },
    /** Check for duplicate child table definition ends **/
    canOpenAnalystWorkbench: function(projectId) { // UI Action 'View in Workspace'
        if (gs.nil(projectId)) {
            return;
        }
        var grProminTable = new GlideRecord("promin_model_def_version");
        grProminTable.addQuery('project', projectId);
        grProminTable.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        grProminTable.setLimit(1);
        grProminTable.query();
        return grProminTable.next() && grProminTable.getValue('state') == 'AVAILABLE';
    },
    getUIActionId: function(projectId) { // Used in promin_project table -> Go To Workbench field (calculated)
        if (gs.nil(projectId)) {
            return;
        }
        var grProminTable = new GlideRecord("promin_model_def_version");
        grProminTable.addQuery('project', projectId);
        grProminTable.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        grProminTable.setLimit(1);
        grProminTable.query();
        if (grProminTable.next() && grProminTable.getValue('state') == 'AVAILABLE' && new global.ProminACLUtil(grProminTable.project).canAccessRestrictedProject())
            return new global.ProminUIAction().getWorkbenchUIactionSysIdForModelDef(); //SysId of UI Action
        return;
    },
    getDynamicQueryForDataSource: function(grProject) {
        if (gs.nil(grProject.sys_updated_by)) { // new model def
            return "tableIN" + this._getAllowedDataSourceTableList();
        } else {
            return "table=" + grProject.table;
        }
    },
    getReferenceQualForSharing: function(grPermission) {
        var refQual = "active=true";
        var projectDomain = grPermission.project.sys_domain;
        if (!gs.nil(projectDomain)) {
            refQual += '^sys_domainINglobal,' + grPermission.project.sys_domain;
        }
        return refQual;
    },
    /*
    	Used in context menu "Launch Process Mining"
    */
    canLaunchPOfromContextMenu: function(table) {
        var isAllowedTable = new ProminAllowedTableList().getAllowedTableList([table]);
        return gs.hasRole("sn_process_optimization_analyst") && !gs.nil(isAllowedTable);
    },
    _getAllowedDataSourceTableList: function() {
        var dataSourceTables = [];
        var gaDataSource = new GlideAggregate("sys_report_source");
        gaDataSource.groupBy("table");
        gaDataSource.query();
        while (gaDataSource.next()) {
            dataSourceTables.push(gaDataSource.getValue("table"));
        }

        if (dataSourceTables.length > 0) {
            return new ProminAllowedTableList().getAllowedTableList(dataSourceTables).toString();
        }
        return "";
    },
    _validateDotWalkLevels: function(grBreakdown) {
        var breakdownValue = grBreakdown.field;
        if (breakdownValue.contains(".")) {
            var limit = gs.getProperty("promin.limit.breakdown_dot_walk", 3);
            var breakdowns = breakdownValue.split(".");
            var levels = breakdowns.length;
            if (levels > parseInt(limit)) {
                throw gs.getMessage("The limit for dot walking in breakdown field is {0} levels", limit);
            }
        }
    },
    _checkDomainOfUserAndGroup: function(grPermission) {
        if (!this.isMSPInstance) {
            return;
        }
        var queryData = {};
        var projectDomain = grPermission.project.sys_domain;

        if (!gs.nil(projectDomain)) {
            queryData["sys_user"] = grPermission.getValue("user");
            queryData["sys_user_group"] = grPermission.getValue("group");

            for (var table in queryData) {
                if (!gs.nil(queryData[table]) && queryData[table].length > 0) {
                    var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
                    gr.addQuery("sys_id", "IN", queryData[table]);
                    gr.addQuery("sys_domain", "!=", "global");
                    gr.addQuery("sys_domain", "!=", projectDomain);
                    gr.setLimit(1);
                    gr.query();

                    if (gr.hasNext()) {
                        throw gs.getMessage("Project can be shared with the user/group of global domain or the domain of Project Definition");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    },
    isLeProgressTypeFieldPresent: function(table) {
        var allQueryTables = "";
        allQueryTables += new TableUtils(table).getTables().toString();
        allQueryTables = allQueryTables.replace(/[\][]/g, '').replace(/ +?/g, '');

        var aggr = new GlideAggregate("sys_dictionary");
        aggr.addQuery("name", "IN", allQueryTables);
        aggr.addQuery("internal_type", "le_progress");
        aggr.addAggregate('COUNT');
        aggr.query();
        if (aggr.next()) {
            return (aggr.getAggregate('COUNT') > 0);
        }
        return false;
    },

    getTableColumns: function(table, types) {
        try {
            var tableName = table;
            var gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            gr.initialize();
            var columns = gr.getFields();
            var columnNames = [];
            var typesLength = types.length;

            for (var i = 0; i < columns.size(); i++) {
                for (var j = 0; j < typesLength; j++) {
                    if (gr.getElement(columns.get(i).getName()).getED().getInternalType() == types[j]) {
                        columnNames.push({
                            id: columns.get(i).getName(),
                            label: gr[columns.get(i).getName()].getLabel()
                        });
                    }
                }
                if (typesLength == 0) {
                    columnNames.push({
                        id: columns.get(i).getName(),
                        label: gr[columns.get(i).getName()].getLabel()
                    });
                }
            }
            return columnNames;
        } catch (err) {
            return [];
        }
    },

    deleteChildTableConfig: function(childConfigId) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('promin_child_table_config');
            if (gr.get(childConfigId)) {
                gr.deleteRecord();
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                error: '',
            };
        } catch (err) {
            return {
                success: false,
                error: gs.getMessage('Error occurred when deleting child table config.'),
            };
        }
    },

    deleteFindingDef: function(findingIds, table) {
        try {
            var findingsArray = findingIds.split(",");
            if (this.findingDefinitionTableAllowed[table] && findingIds && findingsArray.length > 0) {
                var gr = new GlideRecord(this.findingDefinitionTableAllowed[table]);
                var deleteFailedrecordCount = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < findingsArray.length; i++) {
                    if (gr.get(findingsArray[i])) {
                        if (gr.canDelete()) {
                            var res = gr.deleteRecord();
                            if (!res) {
                                deleteFailedrecordCount++;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        deleteFailedrecordCount++;
                    }
                }
                if (deleteFailedrecordCount === findingsArray.length) {
                    return {
                        success: false,
                        error: gs.getMessage('Failed to delete {0} finding definition record(s)', deleteFailedrecordCount),
                    };
                }

                return {
                    success: true,
                    error: '',
                };
            } else {
                gs.error(gs.getMessage('Error occurred when deleting finding definitions'));
                return {
                    success: false,
                    error: gs.getMessage('Error occurred when deleting finding definitions'),
                };
            }
        } catch (err) {
            return {
                success: false,
                error: gs.getMessage('Error occurred when deleting finding definitions'),
            };
        }
    },

    deleteProcessConfig: function(processId) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('promin_process_def');
            if (gr.get(processId)) {
                return gr.deleteRecord();
            }

            return false;
        } catch (err) {
            return false;
        }
    },

    deleteProminPlaybook: function (sysId) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('promin_playbook');
            if (gr.get(sysId)) {
                if (gr.project.getRefRecord().canWrite()) {
                    return gr.deleteRecord();
                }
            }
            return false;
        } catch (err) {
            return false;
        }
    },

    validateIdleTimeConfigForEntity: function(entityId) {
        var entityGr = new GlideRecord("promin_project_entity");
        if (entityGr.get(entityId) && entityGr.getValue("enable_idle_time") == true) {
            var idleTimeFields = {};
            var fieldAndLabel = {};
            var table = entityGr.getValue("table");
            var tableGr = new GlideRecord(table);
            var viewFieldGr = new GlideRecord('promin_view_field_config');
            viewFieldGr.addQuery("process_def.table", table);
            viewFieldGr.addQuery("process_def.content_pack", false);
            viewFieldGr.addQuery("view", "IN", "CONTROL_FLOW,RESOURCE_USER,RESOURCE_GROUP");
            viewFieldGr.query();
            while (viewFieldGr.next()) {
                var field = viewFieldGr.getValue("field");
                if (!gs.nil(field)) {
                    idleTimeFields[viewFieldGr.getValue("view")] = field;
					//get label for the field from tableGR
                    if (tableGr.getElement(field) != null && tableGr.getElement(field).getED() != null &&
                        !gs.nil(tableGr.getElement(field).getED().getLabel())) {
                        fieldAndLabel[field] = tableGr.getElement(field).getED().getLabel();
                    } else {
                        fieldAndLabel[field] = field;
                    }
                }
            }
            var activityGr = new GlideRecord("promin_activity_def");
            activityGr.addQuery("entity", entityId);
            activityGr.addQuery("track_change", false);
            activityGr.addQuery("type", "DEFAULT");
            activityGr.query();
            var isControlFlowFieldPresent = false;
            var isUserFieldPresent = false;
            var isGroupFieldPresent = false;
            while (activityGr.next()) {
                var field = activityGr.getValue("field");
                if (idleTimeFields["CONTROL_FLOW"] == field) {
                    isControlFlowFieldPresent = true;
                } else if (idleTimeFields["RESOURCE_USER"] == field) {
                    isUserFieldPresent = true;
                } else if (idleTimeFields["RESOURCE_GROUP"] == field) {
                    isGroupFieldPresent = true;
                }
            }
            var isConfigValid = true;
            var errorTemplate = "Activity '{0}' is mandatory for {1} metric as a default, non-grouped activity. {1} metric is now disabled. To enable, go to the project setup on process mining workspace.";
            if (!isControlFlowFieldPresent) {
                isConfigValid = false;
                gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage(errorTemplate, [fieldAndLabel[idleTimeFields["CONTROL_FLOW"]],
                    "Idle time"
                ]));
            }
            if (!isUserFieldPresent) {
                isConfigValid = false;
                gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage(errorTemplate, [fieldAndLabel[idleTimeFields["RESOURCE_USER"]],
                    "Idle time"
                ]));
            }
            if (!isGroupFieldPresent) {
                isConfigValid = false;
                gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage(errorTemplate, [fieldAndLabel[idleTimeFields["RESOURCE_GROUP"]],
                    "Idle time"
                ]));
            }
            if (!isConfigValid) {
                entityGr.setValue("enable_idle_time", false);
                entityGr.update();
            }
        }
    },
    type: 'ProminUtils'
};]]></script>
